operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.duration: Instantaneous
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. spells.name: Barrier Field

operational.targets: One fixed center point on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect, with space for a 15-foot-radius hemisphere.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. operational.resolution: Automatic after legal placement. Creation neither displaces nor damages creatures. The field is faintly visible.
operational.effect: Create a 15-foot-radius hemisphere, 15 feet high, with no floor. In both directions its curved boundary blocks attack rolls whose attack/effect path crosses it, including melee reach, and blocks the directly damaging portion of harmful effects crossing it, including save-based or automatic magical damage. Damage from an area on one side does not propagate through the boundary to the other. REVIEWED ORIGIN CLARIFICATION: for a cast that directly deals damage, trace from its caster to the target or initial area origin; merely choosing the area center beyond the field does not bypass it. A damaging part that must cross is blocked regardless of friendly intent or recipient willingness. Other legal, separable non-damaging parts resolve normally. The initial establishment of a persistent damaging source must also satisfy this boundary rule. Once legally established, its subsequent packets use its actual current origin.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Creatures and ordinary nonattack movement cross freely. The field does not block ordinary light, sound or gas, nondamaging control or information magic, teleportation, or effects genuinely originating and resolving entirely on the same side. A previously established independent effect uses its actual source origin and is not ended by field creation. It grants no one-way attacks, HP, item identity, cover item, entrapment, floor, platform or structural support. Unsupported Falling crosses normally without extra movement. It does not erase resolved damage or negate an entire spell merely because its damage across the boundary is blocked. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

spells.name: Alignment Sanctuary

operational.targets: One fixed 10-foot-radius, 10-foot-high area centered on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect. Your casting class selects Abjuration rank 3 or Shaman Conjuration rank 6; rank-6 Conjuration requires both of your canonical alignment axes explicitly recorded before casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Snapshot the caster's actual canonical alignment at application; do not infer it from ancestry, faction, reputation, faith, appearance or conduct. Abjuration rank 3 uses Wisdom saves against your spell DC for opposed entrants. Conjuration rank 6 uses exact matching admission with no save. The snapshot is fixed for this application.
operational.effect: Abjuration rank 3: a creature is opposed if at least one explicitly known axis is exact opposite to the snapshot (Lawful/Chaotic or Good/Evil). Neutral is never opposite; an unknown axis supplies no opposition, and does not erase a known opposite on the other axis. On an opposed creature's attempted entry from outside, roll its Wisdom save before entry, including forced movement, carriage or teleportation. REVIEWED CADENCE CLARIFICATION: record that success or failure for this source character, mode and target until the target's next regular-start marker; the current in-progress start never counts. A success permits entries during that window; failure blocks all non-Falling entry attempts during it without repeat rolls. Same-caster replacement/recasting does not reset this window. Outside initiative, use a fixed 6-second window and preserve its deadline if initiative starts. A failed physical entry stops before the boundary; a failed teleport leaves the creature at its origin without refunding committed teleport costs. Conjuration rank 6: only a creature with both explicit canonical axes exactly matching both snapshotted axes may enter from outside. Unknown is not matching. Nonmatching physical entry, forced movement and carriage stop before entry; a teleport attempt to place a nonmatching creature inside leaves it at origin after costs are committed.
operational.scaling: None. Shaman's preserved Conjuration rank-6 access costs 13 RP before ordinary surcharges; extra RP or character level cannot select another placement.
operational.limitations: Both modes allow existing occupants to remain or leave; once outside, entry restrictions apply. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested, supplies no platform and adds no movement; it can place a creature inside. No AC/save bonus, healing, rest guarantee, resource recovery, attack immunity, concealment, morality compulsion or alignment change. The ward denies entry rather than Actions and does not consume the shared hard-denial ledger. Multiple casters' wards retain independent source permissions and save windows; no single ward's success bypasses another ward. The preserved rank-6 Abjuration aligned-benefits placement has no actual class-access grant and stays unassigned/unavailable; its vague benefits are not imported. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, Abjuration rank-3 opposed-entry Wisdom save and Shaman Conjuration rank-6 same-alignment safe haven. NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: fixed 10-foot-radius/height and concentration 1 minute replace Instantaneous metadata; actual modes stay separate, unassigned rank-6 Abjuration benefits remain blocked. NEW: snapshots, entry/teleport/Falling handling and exact two-axis Conjuration matching. Save-window/recast and rank-6 snapshot-validity completions are jointly reviewed provisional rules.

spells.name: Faction Portal

operational.targets: One legal open local entrance space you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, on suitable ground. Choose one exact canonical factionId with a recorded current reputation score above 0 and one specific known headquarters of that faction.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: No roll. On successful casting create one visible, fixed, one-way doorway 5 feet wide and8 feet high. The destination is a known established public/default receiving point for the chosen headquarters, or, absent such a point, one specific known ordinary primary entrance/foyer. Identify it from personal experience or reliable public information; no existing portal infrastructure is needed. It may be on the same or another plane. Recheck each actual crossing against legal arrival space and exact teleport/planar blockers; failure leaves the crossing creature and belongings at the local entrance, with no split or deletion.
operational.effect:
Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F, doorway to a faction headquarters with positive reputation, actual planar travel supported by Planar tag. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes NEW 1 minute concentration for a usable doorway. NEW: known ordinary receiving-site procedure, fixed one-way 5 x 8 ft entrance, local 5 foot movement cost, whole-group atomic arrival, opaque transport-only interface, any-passenger use, no later reputation tether and exact destination legality. Canon positive predicate is retained without silently changing the reputation scale; route bypass remains possible while actual settlement procedures persist.

spells.name: Future Echo

operational.targets: Yourself and/or any willing allies you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect at resolution, each with an actual regular encounter initiative slot.
operational.duration: Pending until the next numbered round boundary, then one affected round of initiative permutation; no concentration.
operational.resolution: No save. While an encounter initiative order exists, choose the eligible participants and record their desired relative order at resolution. Range, perception, willingness and allied status are checked then, with no later range tether. Outside initiative a legal cast has no scheduling effect and refunds no committed cost. This spell does not create initiative to manufacture a round. One pending Future Echo per caster; a later successful cast before execution replaces that caster’s pending schedule.
operational.effect: After the current round’s final slot and normal end-round events finish, and before the next round’s first regular start, restore any prior round’s Future Echo permutation to the baseline, retaining changes made by other exact initiative rules. Then resolve pending Future Echo schedules in application order, with stable source/mechanical order breaking genuinely simultaneous ties. For each schedule, remove selected participants who no longer possess regular encounter slots and those already claimed by an earlier Future Echo at this boundary. Gather only the remaining participants’ own baseline slot positions, sort those positions earliest to latest, and assign those participants to them in the recorded relative order. Every remaining participant is claimed by that application even if a one-person set leaves its position unchanged. Enemy, unselected and skipped participants’ slots do not move. Removed participants’ abandoned baseline slots are not redistributed. Late entrants not selected at cast resolution are not added automatically. An Incapacitated participant retaining a regular slot remains in the permutation and obeys its actual restrictions.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Each affected participant receives exactly one ordinary regular turn in the affected numbered round, with its normal movement, Action/Bonus Action permissions and regular-start Reaction refresh/recharge/death-save processing as applicable. The permutation itself creates no turn, Action, Reaction, recharge, save, pulse, fall step or recovery. Existing effects retain their previously recorded virtual markers, absolute deadlines and actual periodic clocks; a moved regular turn must not replay an already-scheduled fixed event. Effects newly created during the affected round use the actual schedule then in force. At the following boundary, the prior baseline resumes unless another exact initiative rule changes it; no midround restoration creates a duplicate or missing turn. Pending schedules can be countered, dispelled or suppressed only under an actual applicable rule. A pending schedule unavailable at its execution boundary expires without a delayed makeup. Boundary execution consumes the pending magic and records a fixed one-round turn assignment; later dispelling/suppressing that completed cast does not reverse an already-committed schedule midround. A fresh cast during the affected round can prepare the following round, after baseline restoration. Caster death alone does not erase an independent pending schedule, but a selected caster who loses their actual slot is filtered normally. Source-specific companion turns qualify only if they genuinely own regular slots, not merely for acting after an owner. Full Time Loop and its unimplemented runtime are not enabled by this manuscript. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F and choosing ally initiative order next round. NEW: willing selected set, permutation among existing slots for one round, no concentration, baseline restoration and first-application claims. Exact completions specify baseline-before-next-permutation ordering, singleton claims, suppression at the execution boundary and an atomic schedule commitment that cannot be dispelled into a broken midround order.

It displays ordinary vision from the fixed remote point in all directions; observers may direct their attention around that scene without moving the remote point. Anyone who can ordinarily see the local window can see the unprotected displayed scene. Local Blindness, actual visual obstructions and inability to see the window prevent this viewing. Remote light, darkness, smoke, walls and terrain work normally; the spell grants no darkvision or true sight. If a presence is otherwise visible through the window but its native provenance is undefined/protected, that classification is Indeterminate; it is not reported as nonnative. spells.name: Speak with Dead

operational.targets: One perceived corpse or substantial apparent creature remains within 60 feet and line of effect; eligibility of its deceased identity and retained memories resolves after casting costs commit.
operational.duration: Up to 1 minute or until five question exchanges are spent; no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No save or willing-soul gate. After costs commit, determine whether these are sufficient actual remains of one currently dead creature identity to support an associated retained memory echo. Bones or equivalent substantial creature remains can qualify without an intact mouth, tongue or biological flesh. An active Undead/Construct, an ordinary broken device that was never a creature, identityless ash, a stray blood trace or old remains of a currently living identity do not qualify. If no readable qualifying echo exists, obtain no answers without learning which eligibility/protection fact failed.
operational.effect: Invoke a retained memory echo associated with the addressed remains and deceased identity, not a soul, creature or resurrection. For this application you may spend up to five question exchanges. Each attempted materially unified inquiry and its answer uses one Action in initiative, or approximately six elapsed seconds outside initiative, and one question allowance; the original casting Action includes no free question. Distinct independent subquestions require their own exchanges, Actions and allowances even when spoken as one sentence. You must audibly address the remains from within 60 feet and line of effect; ordinary sound-blocking conditions apply. Each committed exchange spends its allowance even if the question is not understood or its answer is unknown/protected. The echo answers audibly from the remains, truthfully according to the deceased’s actual associated memories and beliefs before death. It uses a language the deceased knew and would reasonably use, with no automatic translation. If no mutually usable language or remembered answer supports a response, it may provide no intelligible answer, I do not know, I do not remember, or the appropriate equivalent. It cannot deliberately lie or withhold a known readable answer from hostility, but mistaken beliefs remain mistaken.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Actual memories associated with the remains govern: this grants no post-death knowledge or automatic later-life memory update to an older fragment after resurrection and another death. Multiple fragments remain one deceased identity, not new people or duplicated souls. A fresh legal paid cast can ask another five; no daily immunity or exclusive global interview slot is added. Each application retains its own quota and deadline; asking an echo does not simultaneously question all other applications. The echo ends if the identity becomes living, the selected physical anchor no longer contains qualifying remains, the five exchanges are spent, or the spell expires/is actually ended. A temporary gap in speaking/range/sound/line of effect pauses no duration. Existing answers and ordinary remembered information persist after ending. Soul Bind or a resurrection-only blocker does not automatically block this memory echo; actual corpse, communication, memory or information protections keep their written scope. The spell generates Divination through Cleric, Mirrorsage, Ranger, Shaman, Wizard or Paladin, and Necromancy through Crimson Agent, Druid or Thief, exactly as the selected casting class’s access row states. A Divination-only ward cannot block a Necromancy cast merely because this shared identity has another school placement. Protection may also filter new information about a separately protected subject within its actual scope. No compelled living creature, identity creation, body animation, healing, resource refresh, skill/proficiency download, objective-history verification or usable recording token results. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

NEW: retained-memory echo, substantial-remains eligibility, truthful subjective answers and one-minute interview. Exact completions put hidden eligibility after payment, require separate paid Action/question exchanges after casting, retain local audible inquiry/range, and bind memories to the actual associated remains rather than silently updating old fragments across later lives.

operational.targets: Choose a point within 15 feet and line of effect for a fixed 15-foot-radius sphere. Each creature physically inside with line of effect from the center is eligible, including allies, yourself and unseen creatures; there is no individually perceived-target or shared-language requirement and no target roster diagnostic.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. A failed-save record restricts communication only while exposed to this fixed zone. In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it.
operational.resolution: Use the actual casting class’s school/rank/price: Enchantment rank 2/base 3 RP for Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard or Paladin access; Divination rank 4/base 7 RP for Cleric, Ranger or Shaman access. Actual minimum class levels and repertoire still apply; paying another price does not grant the other placement. Both modes use a Charisma save. Each creature saves once at its first eligible exposure to this application, either on creation, entry or newly exposed line of effect while already geometrically inside. Success makes it unaffected by this cast for the cast’s remainder. Failure creates a communication restriction which is suppressed outside the sphere or behind total cover and resumes on eligible re-entry/exposure without another save.
operational.effect: An affected creature cannot voluntarily assert as true a proposition it currently believes false with intent to deceive. The prohibition covers speech, writing, sign and another actual language-capable communication method; it grants no new communication ability and requires no shared language with the caster. An attempted deliberate false assertion cannot be voluntarily communicated; the creature may choose a lawful statement or silence. It can refuse, remain silent, evade, omit facts, answer narrowly, use literally true misleading wording, state sincerely mistaken beliefs, identify another person’s words as a quote, or use obvious fiction/jokes/hypotheticals not presented as true facts. It need not reveal a secret or provide useful answers.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No forced speech, objective-truth test, memory search, hidden-belief access or magical disclosure of who saved/failed/is affected is created. The affected creature recognizes its own inability only when it attempts the prohibited assertion, without learning new facts. Existing written records, earlier statements and other people’s observations are not rewritten; ordinary observable behavior remains ordinary evidence, not magical certification. The Divination placement’s behavioral restriction is not magical information acquisition, so Protection from Scrying does not itself authorize lying; independent Divination information effects retain their own protections. The Enchantment placement does not acquire Divination classification. Independent zone casts keep distinct saves, durations, concentration and exposure records; restriction does not stack magnitude, and one successful save does not defeat a different cast. No Charmed, compelled Action, hard-denial use, harm-ending clause or automatic source-rank upgrade is added. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md defines first eligible exposure, independent save histories, temporary total-cover suppression and resumption. The sphere's center stays fixed; moving/teleporting a creature does not move the zone. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both original placements/Core blocks, actual class school/rank/prices, Action/range 15 feet/V,S,F, 15-foot Enchantment radius and cannot-lie/CHA rule. NEW: unified geometry/procedure with concentration minute, CHA harmonization for the unspecified Divination save, one save per exposed creature/application and exact deliberate-assertion scope. The higher Divination price is preserved as an explicit open balance/source redundancy, not an invented extra benefit.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

spells.name: Stitch Fate

operational.targets: One living dying creature at 0 HP you can perceive within range and line of effect. Dead and Stable creatures are ineligible.
operational.duration: Instantaneous
operational.resolution: Choose one mode before paying. Unravel Failure requires at least one recorded failed death save and removes one failure. Stitch Life clears death-save counters and restores 1 HP as direct state recovery.
operational.effect: Unravel Failure leaves the creature dying at 0 HP with its other recorded successes/failures intact. Stitch Life restores a living dying creature to 1 HP, ending its zero-HP dying state. If a broad cannot-regain-HP effect blocks that 1 HP, instead clear its death counters, make it Stable at 0, and roll its ordinary d4-hour recovery deadline from now. A still-active HP prohibition can defer that eventual recovery; damage or death cancels it normally.
operational.scaling: None. The spell changes only one recorded failure or the defined 1-HP state recovery.
operational.limitations: An Action cannot interrupt or retroactively change a completed death. This is not resurrection or ordinary HP healing; ordinary healing bonuses/halves do not alter the 1-HP state value. It removes no Wounds, Corruption, class Curse, conditions, debt or spent-resource consequences. Normal class access, RP, Dissonance, Refrain, components and countering rules apply. No refund after a legally paid cast is countered or fails at resolution.
operational.designNotes: Core Divination rank8, 21RP, Action, 120ft, V/S/F and Instantaneous are preserved. Source says change one failed death save or auto-revive a dying target. NEW: two explicit modes; recorded-failure removal instead of a retroactive reroll; living-dying eligibility; 1-HP state recovery and blocked-recovery Stable bridge. Reviewed operational playtest overlay; provisional design decisions remain labeled NEW.

operational.duration: Pending through the target’s next regular turn, no concentration. Exclude any current in-progress target turn; extra turns do not execute it. Ends no later than that next regular-turn END. Outside initiative, resolve one equivalent ordinary behavior opportunity within 6 elapsed seconds; preserve the deadline rather than leaving an indefinite command.
operational.resolution: If the target cannot hear/understand the instruction, no command applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new instruction. Failure: establish one legal bounded ordinary behavior. If the instruction is wholly impossible/prohibited, no behavior applies and you cannot substitute new wording. A portion commandeering the entire ordinary Action requires the shared hard-control allowance at establishment; if blocked, only independently satisfiable non-hard movement/interaction portions of this same instruction may remain.
operational.effect: At its first legal opportunity on the next regular turn, after start-phase events and before contradictory voluntary choices, the target performs the established instruction using its actual existing movement, at most one ordinary Action and ordinary interaction permissions. A short instruction can specify details beyond one word, such as Drop the red key, Walk away from the doorway or Kneel beside the table. The target/controller chooses legal details not fixed by the instruction. A one-time drop releases the specified releasable item without transferring ownership and permits later normal recovery. A one-time kneel applies Prone if capable, without automatically forbidding later legal standing; explicit still-valid wording to remain kneeling holds that posture through the affected turn. Walk-away uses actual movement, grants no free Dash, follows a known safe legal route and can provoke ordinary opportunity attacks.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No compelled attack, damaging/knowingly harmful act, spellcasting, finite-resource expenditure, self-harm, known serious hazard, protected/private secret disclosure, permanent ownership transfer or knowing binding-oath/duty violation. A newly impossible or prohibited portion fails rather than being rewritten or extending its deadline. One pending Illusive Commands record per target across casters. A later legally established failed-save instruction with at least one valid component replaces it; a saved-against, wholly invalid or wholly guard-blocked new command leaves an existing valid record. No older replaced instruction or spent hard allowance is restored. Compatible components of other actual sources retain their scope and never supply extra budgets. The name creates no illusion image or Illusion-school placement. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across classes, spells and companions. Successfully establishing the hard component claims it once, not each affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing that component never refunds or refreshes the record. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their actual defense checks. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application waiting to activate when immunity ends. Later suppression of an actually established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget. Ordinary compelled Attack Actions, split application IDs, incompatible compulsory budgets and the explicitly bound outside-initiative order/save cadence use the accompanying ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md. This reference grants no additional action budget, sensory feed or otherwise unavailable permission.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S,F and genuine simple-action compulsion, including dropping, walking away and kneeling. NEW: WIS, hearing/language, short-instruction rather than one-word interface, exact future-turn/no-concentration timing, existing-cost procedure and independently valid non-hard portions. Exact review must confirm partial-command replacement and competition with other actual compulsion sources.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

spells.name: Calm Emotions

operational.targets: Choose a point you perceive within 20 feet and line of effect. Create a fixed 20-foot-radius sphere centered there. It can affect all creatures within the sphere with line of effect from its center, including allies, yourself and creatures you do not individually perceive; it supplies no roster or hidden-target diagnostic.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. A successfully applied record is active only during eligible exposure to this fixed zone. In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it.
operational.resolution: At a creature’s first eligible exposure to this application, a willing creature may accept automatically; otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. This is one application-specific acceptance/save decision, not a generic waiver of other spells’ saves. A successful save makes it unaffected by this cast for the rest of this cast, even on re-entry. Acceptance or failure creates this cast’s calm record. Geometrically present creatures behind total cover are not yet exposed; later exposure counts as their first eligible entry. Existing results are never rerolled merely because of leaving/re-entering, temporary cover, changed willingness or a new emotional trigger.
operational.effect: While its accepted/failed-save record is exposed, ordinary intense emotion such as panic, uncontrolled anger, grief or euphoria is subdued, and the mechanical effects of its actual Frightened condition records are suppressed. This includes a new Frightened source applied while calm is active: create that underlying source normally, retain its duration/maintenance and scheduled repeat saves, but suppress its Frightened effects while this calm applies. Leaving the sphere, interposed total cover, ending concentration or this application’s expiry removes this source of suppression. Any still-existing Frightened record can resume when no other valid suppressor remains; no initial one-time application event is replayed.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Acceptance cannot be freely withdrawn to dispel the spell; actual ending/removal permissions still work. No generic Charmed, Stunned, Incapacitated, enchantment, Corrupted, Strain, Dissonance or Refrain removal/suppression is added. A class technique is not disabled because its name/flavor contains rage, fury, empathy or madness: its exact active source must explicitly depend on maintaining an emotional state. Mooncursed, Momentum Rampage, Divine Fury, Fury of the Host and Beast Empathy do not acquire such a dependency here. Their actual separate Frightened riders can be suppressed on affected recipients. Beliefs, memories, grievances, allegiances, judgment and agency remain; this spell does not impose indifference, prevent attacks, end combat, heal resources or repair oaths. Harm is not an additional ending trigger. Independent calm zones retain separate histories and concentration; their identical calming/suppression does not stack numerical magnitude. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md defines first eligible exposure, independent save histories, temporary total-cover suppression and resumption. The sphere's center stays fixed; moving/teleporting a creature does not move the zone. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/range 20 feet/V,S,F and a sphere suppressing strong emotions. NEW: explicit 20-foot radius, fixed center, concentration minute, application-specific willingness/WIS, first-exposure history, conditional ongoing zone membership and actual Frightened suppression only. Exact current class cards substantiate the thematic-name limit. No creature-type restriction or automatic calming of unrelated class mechanics is imported.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. State one reasonable finite course of conduct in ordinary language before the save; actual hearing, understanding, hidden reasonableness and prohibitions are resolved after paid commitment.
operational.duration: Up to eight elapsed hours, no concentration. If that defined task necessarily requires any whole ordinary Actions, even after a future conditional trigger, establish/claim its hard-control component once now. If blocked, only an independently meaningful compliant soft task achievable with legal movement/interactions may establish. A genuinely established soft remainder can replace a prior Suggestion; a wholly invalid, saved-against or wholly blocked attempt cannot. One active Suggestion per target across casters; a later established task replaces the older without restoring it or refunding hard history.
operational.effect: The target genuinely pursues the established reasonable task using only its existing ordinary movement, Action and interaction permissions. Examples include ordinary travel, finite work, waiting/guarding, delivering/retrieving an ordinary item, speaking or meeting someone. An ordinary hostile act is possible only when actually reasonable given its existing beliefs, loyalties, knowledge and circumstances; the caster gains no diagnostic of those facts. Legal route, method and unspecified details remain target/controller choices. The persistent instruction’s priority timestamp is successful establishment and it uses shared Compelled Budget Arbitration at each relevant opportunity. operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.

Reasonable ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks and normal required ammunition within actual limits; optional finite riders and special finite-feature ammunition remain forbidden. A task established without a hard component never acquires one later. If new obstacles would necessarily require an unreserved whole Action, use an achievable legal alternative within its original soft scope or end the remaining compulsion. Mere delay/inconvenience or a temporary obstruction does not end a still-reasonable achievable finite task. No repeat save or separate harm-ending clause is added; new violence/facts may instead make remaining conduct unreasonable. Bonus Actions, Reactions and separately granted extra Actions are not commandeered. No hidden future information or new communication ability is supplied. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

spells.name: Slow

operational.targets: Actual Enchantment mode: choose up to six creatures you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. Actual Transmutation mode: the triggering creature must be perceived within 60 feet and line of effect and must be selected; choose up to five additional such creatures. The actual casting class determines school/mode; paying the same rank-3/base-5-RP price never grants the other package.
operational.duration: Both modes: concentration, up to one minute. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it.
operational.resolution: Enchantment uses an Action and an independent Wisdom save per target. Transmutation uses a Reaction when a creature you perceive within 60 feet/line of effect begins a distinct voluntary movement segment or begins an Action on its own actual turn, after required declaration/commitment and before the segment’s first step or Action’s first main outcome. An extra turn can trigger; Bonus Actions and Reactions cannot. Transmutation gives each chosen target an independent Constitution save. Success: no new effect for that target. Failure: apply only that actual mode’s independently defended rider set. Each affected creature repeats that mode’s recorded WIS or CON save at every affected regular-turn END, including the current regular turn if applied during it; success ends that cast’s application on that creature. Extra turns grant no ending saves. Outside initiative an otherwise legally established ongoing effect uses the specifically bound six-second END-save cadence, never a new Reaction trigger.
operational.effect: Enchantment failure: half Speed under existing strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; -2 AC; -2 Dexterity ability checks and Dexterity saving throws, expressly excluding initiative; and at most one full Action commitment per actual turn. It changes no DEX score/modifier, DEX attack/damage, spell DC or other unnamed derived statistic. AC has only its separate -2. Count an Action already committed before application toward the ceiling; an already-legally-committed second Action still finishes, but no further Action can be committed that turn. The ceiling applies independently on extra turns; it retains Bonus Actions, Reactions and inherent attacks in a legal Attack Action. Transmutation failure: half Speed, -2 AC and no future Reaction commitments. It imposes no DEX penalty or Action ceiling. Already-committed unresolved Reactions remain on the LIFO stack. Neither mode grants unprinted spell delay, attack-count restriction, Action/Bonus-Action interchange, cancellation or teleport restriction.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Transmutation’s movement trigger is one distinct segment, such as moving, performing an Action, then resuming movement; choosing another square during continuous movement is not a new segment, and individual feet/tiles are never new triggers. A paid Slow remains independent if a legal nested interruption removes the original parent Action: resolve it against still-legal selected targets, without refund, revival or parent cancellation. A surviving parent Action continues after the interrupt stack; movement recalculates remaining legal allowance before the next expenditure, keeping all movement already spent. The one-Action ceiling, Reaction denial and other soft riders do not claim whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual narrowly scoped defenses can suppress individual components. Each cast/mode retains separate caster, concentration, saves and deadline. Half-Speed records compete against the same pre-control Speed, then existing later systemic multipliers apply. Identical Slow -2 AC and DEX penalties do not add; independent Enchantment and Transmutation casts may supply their distinct surviving riders together. Enchantment access: Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard, Paladin. Transmutation access: Dragoon, Druid, Mage, Monk, Ranger, Shaman, Tinker. Preserve each exact minimum class level. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

spells.name: Freezing Touch

operational.targets: One creature you perceive and can physically touch within your actual legal reach, with line of effect. The 5-foot reference describes ordinary Touch reach; the spell does not grant extended reach.
operational.duration: Instantaneous damage; delayed Speed rider during one next-regular-turn window, no concentration. Follow the explicit onset/expiry procedure in Effect, rather than applying an immediate one-round slow.
operational.resolution: Make one melee spell attack. Miss: no damage or scheduled rider. Hit: deal 1d4 cold and establish one pending -5-foot Speed rider under its own defenses.
operational.effect: In initiative, schedule onset at the target’s next future regular-turn START, excluding any current turn entirely, and expiry at that same future regular turn’s END. There is no immediate slowing. Start processing precedes voluntary movement; end-phase events precede expiry. If initially cast outside initiative, schedule onset at application +6 elapsed seconds and expiry at +12. If initiative begins while onset is pending, map onset to the next actual regular target START even if before original +6; expiry is the earlier of that affected regular END and original +12. No +6 not-before floor remains, and reaching +12 first ends the pending rider without later activation. If initiative begins after outside onset has occurred, the active rider simply retains its original +12 expiry, with no new full-turn window. Effects initially created in initiative preserve both original future START and corresponding END as virtual markers on exit; no restart. Extra turns neither activate nor consume these regular markers, but an already-active rider affects movement during an extra turn within its active interval. Compute Speed with the existing strongest adverse slow from pre-control Speed, minimum 0, followed by independently applicable system modifiers; retain already-spent movement.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: Multiple Freezing Touch penalties never add -5 repeatedly. Each hit can schedule a separate future window; a hit during an already-slowed regular turn may schedule its next regular turn. Pending/active records retain their own endpoints through suppression, absence, initiative reordering and travel. No Frozen, Rooted, forced movement or whole-Action denial is added. A hit establishes the independent rider under its own defenses even if the damage is reduced to 0; immunity to the damage type alone does not prevent that rider. A later independent application retains its own endpoint; ending one removes only that application, and equal penalties/prohibitions do not stack magnitude. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base rank 0 costs 0 RP but does not waive real extra costs or Refrain. V requires audible speech; S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception. No F is added. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles only actual damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, Touch, V/S, 1d4 cold and -5 feet next turn. NEW: melee spell attack; hit-based independent Speed rider; delayed next-regular-START/END window; outside +6/+12 and exact initiative-entry transition with retained +12 cap. This is not an immediate generic one-round slow.

operational.targets: Select one individually perceptible ongoing magical shield effect and designate one creature it currently protects. A generic defensive benefit does not qualify without that source-qualified identity. Stronger same-stat numerical supersession does not end eligibility; actual complete suppression of every defensive component prevents eligibility until protection resumes. An active conditional defense need not currently be triggered. The actual generating rank controls, not RP spent, discount, dispeller level or a different class placement. Reviewed examples: Arcane Ward, active Shield, active Barrier Flicker, Corruption Ward and unconsumed Minor Elemental Ward qualify subject to all gates. Rank-1 Abjuration Alignment Shield qualifies without a currently attacking opposed-alignment creature; its rank-3 Conjuration application fails the rank ceiling. spells.name: Ghost Sound

operational.targets: One point you can perceive within range from which the sound originates
operational.duration: Instantaneous; the created sound may last no longer than 6 seconds
operational.resolution: No roll when created. A creature actively scrutinizing the sound while it is occurring may use an Action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the sound as illusory.
operational.effect: Create one minor illusory sound from the chosen point, such as footsteps, a knock, a whisper, an animal noise, a dropped object, or another brief sound no louder than a normal shout.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Cannot deal damage, create thunder or sonic force, reproduce a supernatural command, supply a verbal spell component, perfectly authenticate another creature's identity, or transmit hidden knowledge you do not possess. The sound creates no physical source or cover. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are preserved. The 6-second maximum and exact Investigation-vs-Spell-DC disbelief procedure are NEW provisional illusion mechanics.

spells.name: Minor Image

operational.targets: One visual illusion fitting entirely inside a 5-foot cube whose nearest point is within range
operational.duration: Concentration, until the start of your next regular turn
operational.resolution: The illusion appears automatically. A creature that uses an Action to scrutinize it makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the image as illusory.
operational.effect: Create a static visual illusion that fits inside a 5-foot cube. It can depict a creature, object, surface feature, or visible phenomenon but produces no sound, smell, heat, force, or physical substance.
operational.scaling: None.

spells.name: Shapechange

operational.targets: Self
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Choose one legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile on cast. No save. Once on each of your original regular turns afterward, you may use a Bonus Action to switch to a different legal profile. The new anatomy must fit the available space. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath. No internal switch on the casting turn or an extra turn; first switch is the next original regular turn, then at most one on each later original regular turn.
operational.effect: You retain your identity, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, resources, initiative and existing effects. Only your current anatomy/profile changes. Each supplied natural attack uses your current spell attack bonus and M. Profile switching does not create a new body, heal, refresh resources, restore temporary HP or reset rest/recharge uses.
operational.scaling: No automatic scaling beyond the bounded R4+R9 profile register.
operational.limitations: Only one Shapechange anatomy exists at a time. An identical-profile switch is rejected before Bonus Action payment. Internal switches are not spell casts and do not create new Dissonance or Refrain events. Equipment remains melded through switches. Losing flight while unsupported begins ordinary falling. Actual 0 HP, death or Incapacitated after same-packet prevention ends Shapechange without healing. The spell grants no Druid Buffer Reserve, Form Surge, Shapeshift use or Druid form features. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Shapechange identity, Rank 9, Druid/Mage/Wizard access and class-specific schools, Action, source 120-foot metadata, V/S/F, base 26 RP, and the core concept of changing creature form each round. NEW: operational target narrowed to Self, one-minute concentration, Bonus Action once-per-original-regular-turn switching, finite R4/R9 profiles and same-body state rules. The original 120-foot source field remains preserved in provenance despite the self-target operational narrowing.

operational.targets: One willing dead creature whose sufficiently intact remains are within range and line of effect, and whose death occurred no more than 8 elapsed hours ago

Normal RP, Dissonance, Refrain and component rules apply.

operational.targets: One living dying creature at0HP you can perceive within range and line of effect; a Dead or Stable creature is ineligible
operational.duration: Pending tether up to1 minute; if target dies while pending, bound identity for24 elapsed hours from that death
operational.resolution: Target makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On success no effect. On failure create a pending Soul Bind tether with an absolute expiry60 seconds after resolution. After conversion, that identity cannot return by resurrection until the24-hour record ends or a legally capable source removes it. Neither state requires concentration or ends merely because a caster dies/incapacitates. If death begins at or after the pending absolute expiry, conversion does not occur. Only one Soul Bind family record may exist per identity; another failed-save application while still living/dying refreshes to the later pending endpoint without stacked prisons. A generic cure or under-ranked dispel is not sufficient. The spell grants no commands, ownership, memories, personality change or control over the player. Soul-specific temporal restoration uses its own reviewed interface. Normal costs, Dissonance, Refrain and countering apply.
operational.designNotes: Core Necromancy rank9, 26RP, Action, 120ft, V/S/F and dying-target/resurrection-block purpose retained with Cleric/Druid/Wizard17 access. NEW: Charisma save,1-minute pending/24-hour bound states, no concentration, exact expiry collision, source-family refresh and local removal anchor. These replace the otherwise nonoperational Instantaneous summary with explicit finite aftermath. Wider soul cosmology remains open; individually reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.

spells.name: Harmonic Bulwark

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within 60 feet
operational.duration: Cast instantaneous; accepted temporary HP last until depleted, replaced, or the recipient completes a long rest
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal payment; temporary-HP strongest-only arbitration then applies.
operational.effect: The chosen willing recipient receives a temporary-HP offer equal to 5 times credited RP. Credited RP is actual base RP paid after exact legal base-cost reductions plus chosen additional X from0..PB. X cannot be discounted. Ordinary surcharges never count toward credited RP. Use canonical ordinary-cast pricing; Refrain changes post-cast Dissonance and is not a new RP surcharge.
operational.scaling: 5 temporary HP per credited RP. Additional conversion RP X is capped by proficiency bonus and must actually be paid.
operational.limitations: Additional conversion RP cannot itself be discounted. Payment occurs before nonstack arbitration and is not refunded when a stronger or equal shield remains. A cast with zero credited RP is illegal. Free casts/copies that spend no credited RP create no fresh Harmonic Bulwark shield unless their own exact copy rule expressly copies an already-resolved temporary-HP event. Temporary HP are not healing and use the canonical one-active-buffer rule. Choose X before commitment. Commit Action plus quoted casting payment plus X before countering or arbitration; no post-commit refund. A countered spell offers nothing.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Harmonic Bulwark identity, Universal Rank 3, class access/learn levels/base 5 RP, and 5 temporary HP per RP source wording. NEW: Action, 60-foot range, one willing target, V/S/F components, PB cap on discretionary RP, exact credited-RP accounting, and V6-default shield lifetime. Action/range/components resemble the unproven Mana Shield candidate but are adopted only as provisional Harmonic Bulwark design choices; the alias is not treated as source identity.
